# `typeUnionToSchemaUnion`

Suggests composing unions of Schema .Type/.Encoded types with Schema.Union and deriving the type from it

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377159` |
| Language Service name | `typeUnionToSchemaUnion` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/type-union-to-schema-union` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Schema } from "effect"

export const Circle = Schema.Struct({ kind: Schema.Literal("circle"), radius: Schema.Number })
export const Square = Schema.Struct({ kind: Schema.Literal("square"), side: Schema.Number })

export type Shape = typeof Circle.Type | typeof Square.Type
/**
            ^^^^^ effecttsgo(type-union-to-schema-union): This type alias unions Schema `.Type` types without a runtime schema; compose them with `Schema.Union` and derive the type from it.
*/
```
